1.name: Fearlessness
1.painPoint: I'm scared of failure, rejection, judgment
seeds: I'm terrified of speaking in front of my class and looking stupid
Everyone is judging my clothes and how I talk
I have major exam anxiety and feel paralyzed
Scared of rejection if I ask someone or try something new
Stage fright makes my hands shake during presentations
Mujhe stage pe bolne me bohot dar lagta hai
Exam ka bohot darr lag raha hai fail ho gaya toh kya hoga
Log kya kahenge agar main fail ho gaya
I'm scared to put myself out there because of judgment
Constant fear of making a fool of myself in public

2.name: Self-Faith
2.painPoint: I'm not good enough / self-doubt / insecurity
seeds: I feel like an imposter and everyone will realize I'm not that smart
I doubt myself every single day, I feel completely talentless
Everyone else seems confident but I feel like a total loser
I don't think I'm good enough to get this job or pass
Deep insecurity that I don't deserve the good things in my life
Apne aap par bilkul vishwas nahi hota lagta hai main sabse peeche hu
Lagta hai main fraud hu sab mujhe over-smart samajhte hain
I have zero self-esteem and constantly tear myself down
I keep asking others for validation because I don't trust myself
I feel completely unworthy and lack any self-belief

3.name: Focus
3.painPoint: My mind is everywhere / phone addiction / overthinking
seeds: I keep checking Instagram reels while studying and can't concentrate
My attention span is completely fried, I can't read a page without checking my phone
Padhte waqt dhyan bhatak jata hai aur 2 ghante phone scroll ho jata hai
I overthink every small detail and can't get any work done
Brain rot from endless doom-scrolling, my brain feels foggy
Cannot sit down for 30 minutes of deep focus without getting distracted
Dhyan ek jagah tikta hi nahi hai, mann idhar udhar bhatakta hai
Constant notifications breaking my workflow and train of thought
Mind is everywhere at once, jumping from thought to thought
Procrastinating on my laptop opening twenty tabs instead of working

4.name: Purpose
4.painPoint: I don't know what I'm doing with my life / career confusion
keywords: what to do with my life
kya karu samajh nahi aa raha
seeds: I have no idea what I'm doing with my life and feel completely lost
Confused about my career path, there are too many options and no clear direction
Mujhe samajh nahi aa raha main apni life ke saath kya karu
All my friends have chosen their careers and I'm just drifting aimlessly
I don't know what my passion or purpose is, everything feels arbitrary
Feeling stuck at a crossroads, afraid to pick the wrong college or job
Zindagi me koi lakshya nahi dikh raha bas din kat rahe hain
Should I follow stability or passion? I have no one clear idea
Drifting from one half-dream to another without committing to anything
No north star in life, total confusion about who I want to become

5.name: Persistence
5.painPoint: I failed / setbacks / wanting to quit
seeds: I failed my exam again and I just want to give up and quit
Got rejected from five job interviews in a row, I'm done trying
Har baar koshish karta hu aur har baar fail ho jata hu, ab himmat nahi bachi
I put months of effort into this project and it crashed completely
Feeling like throwing in the towel because nothing is working out
Repeated setbacks make me feel like I should just walk away
Ek saal preparation ki phir bhi result nahi aaya, ab man karta hai chhod du
Why keep trying when every attempt ends in embarrassment?
Tired of dusting myself off only to fall right back down
I want to quit everything, the mountain is just too high

6.name: Strength
6.painPoint: I'm drained, anxious, burnt out / mentally weak
seeds: I'm completely burnt out, working 14 hours a day and running on empty
Mentally drained to the point where even getting out of bed feels hard
Body is exhausted, brain feels weak, zero physical or mental energy left
Bohot thak chuka hu dimag bilkul blank ho gaya hai burnout ho raha hai
Anxiety and exhaustion have broken my resilience completely
Feeling mentally weak, every tiny problem feels like an avalanche
Running on caffeine and stress, sleep schedule is totally destroyed
Meri mental energy zero ho chuki hai, kisi cheez ka dam nahi bacha
Deep burnout from months of continuous pressure and no recovery
I feel frail and brittle inside, easily snapped by the smallest stress

7.name: Self-Mastery
7.painPoint: Can't control thoughts, emotions, habits / anger / envy
keywords: bura lagta hai doosro ko dekh kar
seeds: I lose my temper over tiny things and regret it immediately afterwards
Seeing everyone succeed on Instagram makes me violently jealous and bitter
I can't control my impulses and keep relapsing into bad habits
Gusse me kuch bhi bol deta hu aur baad me pachhtata hu
Envy is eating me alive whenever my friends post their achievements
Zero self-control over my emotions, a single comment ruins my whole day
Doosron ko dekh kar lagta hai sab aage nikal gaye, jealousy hoti hai
Addicted to cheap dopamine and cannot rule my own mind
Reactionary behavior: I snap at people I care about and can't pause
Constantly seeking validation from others and obsessing over their approval

8.name: Service
8.painPoint: Stuck in myself / life feels empty / want larger meaning
keywords: sab kuch hoke bhi khush nahi
seeds: I hit my personal goals but life still feels hollow and empty inside
Stuck inside my own tiny ego, I want my life to matter for something bigger
Sab kuch hai mere paas phir bhi ek ajeeb sa khalipan mehsoos hota hai
I want to help others and contribute to society, not just chase money
Self-centered ambition is making me feel isolated and depressed
Why am I only living for myself? There has to be a larger meaning
Success feels meaningless without serving something greater than me
Khel khatam hone ke baad bhi khushi nahi mili, kuch bada karna hai desh ya logo ke liye
Tired of obsessing about my own career and want to build something for others
Yearning for a sense of service and genuine compassion for people around me
